home.promise.device.title: Stays on your device
home.promise.device.text: Your details and photo are saved only in this browser. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account to create.
home.promise.free.title: Free, with no watermark
home.promise.free.text: Every design, every download. No payment, no sign-up and no ads.
home.promise.language.title: Your language, your format
home.promise.language.text: Headings in English, Telugu, Hindi and seven more Indian languages, on an A4 page ready to print or share.
privacy.metaDescription: Your biodata stays in your browser: how Free Wedding Biodata stores your details and photo, and how to remove them.
privacy.title: Your biodata stays with you
privacy.lead: {name} has no accounts and no database. Everything you type and every photo you add stays in this browser, on this phone or computer.
privacy.promise.device.title: Saved on this device
privacy.promise.device.text: Drafts and photos are kept in your browser's own storage.
privacy.promise.made.title: Made here
privacy.promise.made.text: PDFs and images are made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
privacy.promise.signup.title: No sign-up
privacy.promise.signup.text: No name, phone number or email is ever asked for.
privacy.where.title: What stays on your device
privacy.where.1: Everything you type and the photo you add are saved in this browser's own storage (IndexedDB) on this device. They are not sent to any server: the site is a set of plain files, with no database and no accounts.
privacy.where.2: Because there is no account, your drafts don't follow you to another phone or computer. Moving a draft will take a backup file, which is on the way.
privacy.sent.title: What leaves your device
privacy.sent.1: Nothing you enter. The editor is locked by a security policy that lets it talk only to this website, so even a mistake in the code couldn't send your details anywhere else.
privacy.sent.2: Your biodata leaves your device only when you choose: when you download it, print it or share it.
privacy.sent.3: This site has no analytics yet. If visit counting is added, it will be on the public pages only (this page, the home page, help), never in the editor.
privacy.keep.title: Keep your drafts safe
privacy.keep.note: Browser storage belongs to this browser on this device. It can be lost when you clear browsing data, use a private window, or the device runs low on space. Backup files are on the way: once they arrive, download one whenever you finish an important change.
privacy.keep.2: Anyone who uses this browser profile can open your drafts. On a shared computer, delete them when you're done.
privacy.remove.title: Delete everything
privacy.remove.1: To delete one draft, open the list of drafts in the editor (its name, at the top) and choose Delete. To remove every draft and photo at once, use Delete all my local data, here or in that list. Clearing this site's data in your browser settings does the same.
privacy.remove.2: Nothing is kept anywhere else, so once it's deleted here, it's gone.
privacy.glance.title: At a glance
privacy.glance.3: No ads, and nothing tracks the editor
privacy.code.title: Check it yourself
privacy.code.text: The code is open source, so anyone can see exactly what the site does.
privacy.help.title: Questions?
privacy.help.text: How saving, languages and printing work.
privacy.deleteAll.title: Delete all my local data
privacy.deleteAll.text: Removes every draft and photo from this browser.
help.metaDescription: How to make a marriage biodata with Free Wedding Biodata: filling it in, where drafts are saved, languages, printing on A4 and common questions.
help.title: How to make your biodata
help.lead: Fill in your details, check the page exactly as it will print, and download it. It all happens in this browser, so nothing you type is uploaded.
help.status: The editor is still being built, in the open. This page describes how it works; parts that haven't arrived yet say so.
help.how.title: How it works
help.how.fill.title: Fill in your details
help.how.fill.text: Personal, education, career, family and horoscope sections. Empty fields aren't printed.
help.how.preview.title: Check the preview
help.how.preview.text: The preview is the printed page itself, so what you see is what you'll send.
help.how.download.title: Download or print
help.how.download.text: Save a PDF or an image to share on WhatsApp, or print it on A4 paper.
help.how.after: You can change the design and its colours at any time; your details stay as they are.
help.saving.title: Saving and backups
help.saving.1: Drafts are saved as you type, in this browser's own storage (IndexedDB) on this device. There is no account, and nothing is sent to a server.
help.saving.2: Browsers can clear that storage: when you clear browsing data, use a private window, or the device runs low on space. A browser on another phone or computer can't see your drafts either.
help.saving.3: Backups are on the way: one small file with your text and photo, to keep safe or open on another device. This page will say when they're ready.
help.languages.title: Languages
help.languages.1: The editor is in English. The printed headings (Name, Date of birth, Father's name and so on) can be in English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali or Punjabi.
help.languages.2: What you type is printed exactly as you type it, in any script: your name in Telugu with English headings, or the other way round.
help.languages.3: The fonts are part of the site, so the page looks the same on every phone and printer.
help.printing.title: Printing
help.printing.lead: A biodata is laid out on an A4 page. In your browser's print window:
help.printing.2: Set the scale to 100% ("Actual size"), not "Fit to page", so the borders stay where they belong.
help.printing.3: Turn on "Background graphics" so colours and borders print.
help.printing.4: Turn off headers and footers, which add the date and web address.
help.printing.5: For copies you hand over in person, thicker matte paper (100–120 gsm) looks best.
help.faq.title: Common questions
help.faq.free.a: Yes. Every design and every download, with no watermark, no ads and no paid version. If it helps your family, you can buy the maker a coffee, but it's never required.
help.faq.account.q: Do I need to sign up?
help.faq.account.a: No. There's no account, login or email. You open the site and start.
help.faq.who.a: Only people using this browser on this device. Your details and photo are saved in the browser and never uploaded. The privacy page explains how.
help.faq.device.q: Can I continue on another phone or computer?
help.faq.device.a: Not yet. Drafts stay in the browser where you made them. Backup files, which move a draft to another device, are on the way.
help.faq.watermark.q: Is the website's name printed on my biodata?
help.faq.watermark.a: No. Only what you enter is printed: no site name, web address or watermark.
help.faq.matrimony.a: No. It's a document tool only: it doesn't match, list or connect people, and nobody sees your biodata unless you send it.
help.faq.offline.a: Your biodata is made on your device, not on a server. Working fully offline, once the site has been opened, is planned for a later update.
help.faq.script.q: My language isn't one of the ten. Can I still use it?
help.faq.script.a: Yes. Type your details in any script and they print as typed. Only the printed headings are limited to the ten languages.
help.support.title: Support the project
help.support.1: {name} is free and open source, made by one person. If it helped your family, you can buy me a coffee.
help.support.2: Found a mistake or have an idea? Report it on GitHub.
help.aside.editor.title: Make your biodata
help.aside.editor.text: The editor opens in this browser. Nothing you type leaves it.
help.aside.privacy.title: Your privacy
help.aside.privacy.text: Where your details are kept, and how to remove them.
help.aside.coffee.title: Free, and always will be
help.aside.coffee.text: If it helped your family, you can buy the maker a coffee. Never required.
editor.title: Your biodata
editor.shownTip: Printed on the biodata. Press to hide it; what you typed is kept.
editor.hiddenTip: Hidden from the biodata; what you typed is kept. Press to show it again.
editor.date.asTyped: Prints exactly as typed. Type it as dd-mm-yyyy, like 15-03-1998, to have it formatted.
editor.time.asTyped: Prints exactly as typed. Type it like 6:45 AM to have it formatted.
editor.select.none: No match: what you type prints as typed.
editor.charsLabel: {n} characters; about {max} fit well on a one-page biodata
editor.placeholder.annualIncome: Optional, for example ₹ 12 lakh per year
editor.placeholder.residence: For example, own house in Guntur
editor.placeholder.otherFamilyInfo: Anything else about your family you'd like to share
editor.placeholder.aboutMe: For example: I am a calm, cheerful person who enjoys cooking and music. I value honesty and time with family, and I'm looking for a kind, curious partner.
editor.placeholder.partnerHeightRange: For example, 5 ft 2 in and above
editor.placeholder.partnerOccupation: For example, working or not, her choice
editor.placeholder.partnerExpectations: For example: someone kind, family-minded and independent, who enjoys travel and simple living.
editor.hint.phone: Indian numbers with or without +91. Written exactly as you type it.
editor.note.title: Saved on this device only
editor.note.text: Your biodata stays in this browser's storage and is never sent anywhere. Clearing browsing data, or using a private window, can remove it.
drafts.failed: That didn't work, and nothing was changed. Please try again.
drafts.notSaved: Your latest changes aren't saved yet, so nothing was done. See the message above the form.
rename.title: Rename this draft
rename.description: The name is only for you, to find this draft in the list. It's never printed on the biodata.
rename.label: Draft name
rename.hint: Leave it empty to name it after the Full name, like “{example}”.
delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.text: This deletes the draft and its photos from this browser. It can't be undone.
delete.brokenText: This draft can't be opened, so nothing in it can be recovered here. Deleting it removes it from this browser.
deleteAll.title: Delete all your local data?
deleteAll.text: This deletes every draft and photo saved in this browser, and your theme choice. Nothing is kept anywhere else, so it can't be undone.
deleteAll.label: Type DELETE to confirm
deleteAll.failed: Your data couldn't be deleted. Close this site's other tabs, then try again. Nothing was deleted.
storage.title: Storage on this device
storage.usageUnknown: This browser doesn't say how much space your drafts use.
storage.kept: Protected: this browser won't clear your drafts to free up space.
storage.notKept: Not protected: this browser may clear your drafts if the device runs low on space.
storage.keptUnknown: This browser doesn't say whether it may clear your drafts to free up space.
storage.granted: Done. This browser will keep your drafts until you clear them yourself.
storage.declined: This browser said no for now. Browsers decide this themselves, often after you've used a site for a while or added it to your home screen. Your drafts are still saved.
storage.failed: This browser couldn't answer just now. Your drafts are still saved.
storage.clearing: Clearing browsing data, or this site's data, deletes your drafts even when they're protected.
save.quota.title: Your device is out of space for this site
save.quota.text: Your latest changes aren't saved yet. Free some space on this device (photos, videos or apps you no longer need), then press Try again. Keep this tab open until it says Saved.
save.conflict.title: This draft was changed in another tab
save.conflict.text: This tab has stopped saving, so neither tab overwrites the other. Reload to see the latest version; anything typed here since then won't be kept.
save.unavailable.title: Your browser isn't letting this site save
save.unavailable.text: Your latest changes aren't saved. Private windows and some privacy settings block this site's storage. Keep this tab open, allow this site to store data, then press Try again.
save.unknown.title: Your latest changes couldn't be saved
save.unknown.text: Something went wrong while saving. Your changes are still here in this tab; press Try again.
open.missing.title: Draft not found
open.missing.text: This browser has no draft at this address. Drafts are kept only in the browser where they were made, so a link from another phone or computer won't open here.
open.broken.title: This draft couldn't be opened
open.broken.invalid: Its saved data is damaged or incomplete. It has been kept exactly as it is: nothing was changed or deleted.
open.broken.tooNew: It was saved by a newer version of this app. Reload the page to get the latest version. The draft has been kept exactly as it is.
open.unavailable.title: Your browser isn't letting this site save
open.unavailable.text: Private windows and some privacy settings stop this site from keeping your biodata in the browser's storage. Open the editor in a normal window, or allow this site to store data, then try again.
open.failed.title: Your draft couldn't be loaded
open.failed.text: Something went wrong while reading this browser's storage. Nothing was changed or deleted.
notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.text: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved. Anything saved in this browser is safe.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: This page ran into a problem. Try again, or go back to the home page. Anything saved in this browser is safe, and nothing was sent anywhere.
photo.empty.title: Add your photo
photo.empty.text: Optional, but most families look for one. It's printed beside your details.
photo.tip.light: Good, even light, such as near a window
photo.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 25 MB. It stays on this device.
photo.alt: Your photo, as it will be printed
photo.missing: This photo couldn't be read from this browser's storage. Choose Change to add it again, or Remove.
photo.frame.label: Frame
photo.lowRes.title: This photo may print blurry
photo.lowRes.text: At its printed size it has about {dpi} dots per inch; 200 or more looks sharp. Use a larger or sharper photo, or zoom out a little.
photo.removeDialog.title: Remove this photo?
photo.removeDialog.text: It's deleted from this draft on this device. You can add a photo again at any time.
photo.error.type: This file isn't a photo that can be used here. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
photo.error.size: This photo is over 25 MB. Choose a smaller copy of it.
photo.error.empty: This file is empty. Choose another photo.
photo.error.heic: This browser can't open HEIC photos. Choose a JPEG instead: on an iPhone, pick the photo from your Photos (it's converted for you) or set Camera › Formats to Most Compatible.
photo.error.decode: This photo couldn't be opened. It may be damaged; try another one.
photo.error.memory: This photo is too large for this device to open. Try a smaller copy.
photo.cropper.title: Crop your photo
photo.cropper.description: Drag to move it. Pinch, scroll or use the slider to zoom.
photo.cropper.area: Photo in its frame. Arrow keys move it; plus and minus zoom.
photo.cropper.lowRes: Zoomed in this far, it may print blurry (about {dpi} dpi).
